sprint_goal: Make every 'always enforced' ClearGate gate actually block again after the CR-070/CR-074 execution_mode retirement — no dead vocabulary, no silent no-ops, and a guard so canonical↔live drift cannot recur.

meta.note: Outer meta-repo. Holds canonical (cleargate-planning/**) + live-root (.cleargate/**, root CLAUDE.md) + the gitignored live /.claude. All non-cli story surfaces are here.

cli.note: Separate git repo, gitignored in the outer repo. Holds cleargate-cli/src/**, cleargate-cli/test/**, and the payload mirror cleargate-cli/templates/cleargate-planning/**. Payload + cleargate-planning/MANIFEST.json are DERIVED artifacts regenerated by `npm run prebuild` (build-manifest.ts + copy-planning-payload.mjs) — never hand-edited, never a per-story collision surface. Regenerate ONCE after each wave's canonical edits land; do not commit per-branch prebuild output.

collision_model_note: Genuine collision surfaces are (a) canonical cleargate-planning/** hand-edits, (b) live-root .cleargate/** + root CLAUDE.md hand-edits, (c) cleargate-cli/src|test/** hand-edits. EXCLUDED from the collision surface (deferred, deterministic regeneration): cleargate-cli/templates/cleargate-planning/** (payload mirror) and cleargate-planning/MANIFEST.json — both are `npm run prebuild` outputs, whitelisted, regenerated once per wave. The gitignored /.claude live copies are hand-synced at merge/Gate-4, not staged (framework cross-repo model).
lane_rationale: All 9 forced standard by orchestrator dispatch ('all lane: standard — no fast lane'). Independently rubric-confirmed: every story either edits a forbidden-surface class (enforcement gate scripts / readiness-predicate lib / runtime config-schema-adjacent scaffold), or has expected_bounce_exposure=med (03/06/07/08/09), or is multi-file/L3 (05/06/07/09) — each trips ≥1 fast-lane disqualifier. milestone_barrier: Waves NEVER cross a milestone boundary. M0 fully merges before M1 starts; M1 fully merges before M2 starts. This barrier auto-satisfies every cross-milestone shared-file edge (03→05/07 on sprint.ts/readiness-gates.md; 02→08 on enforcement.md; 05→08/09 and 07→08/09 on CLAUDE.md/protocol.md) without an explicit intra-wave dependency.

cross_cutting_execution_notes: Dogfood three-copy discipline (canonical -> live-root -> payload) is the dominant hazard this sprint (CR-074 / FLASHCARD 2026-07-17 #dogfood #sync): blind `cp` canonical->live has already DESTROYED live-only content. Every story mitigation mandates diff-before-overwrite; the payload is the only automated copy (`npm run prebuild`).

STORY-051-06 is itself the guard that hereafter enforces this three-copy sync — but it is authored in the SAME sprint whose earlier waves create drift. Its drift-guard test uses tmpdir fixtures, so it does not fail on the live meta-repo's transient in-flight drift; the live-repo drift it reports (stale qa.md, root CLAUDE.md) is the intended real-world proof and is resolved as 05/07 merge.

Framework cross-repo model: cli edits land on cleargate-cli's main-checkout branch (separate repo), not an outer worktree. Live /.claude hand-sync + dist rebuild are deferred to Gate-4 per project convention.
